categories.main_business_segments: Aica Kogyo operates two main business segments: Chemical Products (Kaseihin) and Building & Housing Materials (Kensou Kenza). The Chemical Products segment includes adhesives, coatings, flooring materials, and organic microparticles, while the Building & Housing Materials segment covers decorative laminates, interior doors, counters, storage doors, fire-resistant decorative materials, and extruded cement boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced resin and adhesive technologies, including phenolic resins, hot-melt adhesives, and UV/urethane resins. It emphasizes high-functionality, process simplification, and environmental adaptation, such as water-based epoxy flooring, biomass-derived phenolic resins, and high-durability decorative laminates. Manufacturing integrates proprietary compounding, surface treatment, and design technologies, with a focus on sustainability and reduced environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Aica Kogyo primarily serves the construction, housing, furniture, and interior design industries, supplying materials to residential, commercial, and public facility projects. It also targets non-construction sectors such as automotive, electronics, and consumer goods, especially for functional materials and adhesives. Key customers include manufacturers, contractors, and distributors in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong presence in Japan and significant operations across Asia and Oceania, including China, Southeast Asia (notably Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore), India, Taiwan, and New Zealand. Overseas sales account for nearly half of total revenue, with production and sales bases strategically located in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aica Kogyo operates primarily midstream in the supply chain, producing intermediate materials and components (such as adhesives and decorative panels) that are supplied to manufacturers, builders, and fabricators for integration into end products and construction projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include improving profitability, expanding high-value-added products, and accelerating overseas growth. R&D focuses on sustainability (decarbonization, biomass materials), high-performance and design-oriented products, process efficiency, and solutions for social issues. The company invests heavily in human capital, digitalization, and global talent development, and pursues M&A for portfolio enhancement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products (adhesives, coatings, decorative panels, building materials) to B2B customers. The company also engages in OEM supply, licensing, and, to a lesser extent, service and consulting related to product application and installation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Aica Kogyo is a market leader in Japan for melamine decorative laminates and holds strong positions in adhesives and building materials. Major competitors include other Japanese and Asian chemical/materials firms such as Sumitomo Bakelite, Sekisui Chemical, and international players in adhesives and laminates. The company differentiates itself through technology, design, and a robust global network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 248.7 billion yen, with operating profit of 27.4 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 16.9 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth, with a 5.1% increase in sales and 11.6% increase in net profit year-on-year. Overseas sales comprise about 48% of total revenue, and the company maintains a strong balance sheet with a 60.2% equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aica Kogyo emphasizes the fusion of chemistry and design, offering high-quality, high-durability, and aesthetically advanced materials that address both functional and environmental needs. Its value proposition centers on innovation, safety, sustainability, and the ability to provide comprehensive solutions for diverse construction and industrial applications, supported by a global production and sales network.
